title: Women's Running – Here for the Free Banana. Hoodie

seo.title: Funny Running Hoodie for Women: Here for the Free Banana.
seo.description: A funny running hoodie for women: a ponytailed runner racing for a banana, HERE FOR THE FREE BANANA. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This funny running hoodie for women is for the runner who admits the finish-line banana is the real prize, and wears it to every 5K, race morning and cold training loop.

A ponytailed runner in a striped headband and tube socks sprints across a ribbon of red, blue and cream track with a peeled banana held high. HERE FOR THE runs above in heavy letters and FREE BANANA. below.

Pull it on for the start-line shiver, the post-race snack table and every group run that ends at the bakery. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Women's Running Here for the Free Banana. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the lettering is printed in navy and brick red, and on Navy it is cream and mustard yellow, so every word stays easy to read from across the start line on either color.

Is it a good gift for a runner?
Yes. The Women's Running Here for the Free Banana. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. gives any 5K regular a joke about the snack table they already live for, in an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for cold race mornings. Order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Free Banana. hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Free Banana. hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier fit over a long sleeve or a running vest on chilly mornings.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the printed lettering and the running banana scene looking sharp through every training block.

Where does the print sit?
The Here for the Free Banana. print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, with HERE FOR THE over the runner and FREE BANANA. beneath, so both lines read from across the room. The hood is double-lined with a matching drawcord.
